title: Adventure Finder: Family Days Out by Age, Place and Cost
description: Find your next family day out: filter 100+ adventures by age, location, cost, indoor or outdoor and type. Theme parks, escape rooms, free days out and more.
intro: Filter more than 100 days out by age, location, cost and type. Tiny explorers, bored teenagers or the whole gang: Scout’s got something for everyone.

image.alt: Riding a zip line through a forest

blocks.title: How to use the finder
blocks.text: Tap the chips to filter, or hit 🎲 Surprise me for a random idea. “Near you” means a kind of day out you’ll find near most homes, like trampoline parks or rock pooling.
points: Filters can be shared: copy the web address
Cost bands are a rough guide, not prices
Every card links to Scout’s guide or the official site

blocks.title: All adventures
blocks.intro: Pick an age, a place and a budget.

faqs.q: What do the cost bands mean?
faqs.a: They’re a rough editorial guide to a typical family visit: Free, £ Budget (a cheap treat), ££ Mid-range (a typical paid attraction) and £££ Splurge (a big-ticket day or trip). They aren’t prices. Always check the official site.
Types of day out you’ll find near most homes, such as trampoline parks, farm parks, skate parks or rock pooling, rather than one specific venue.
